calibration.method: Platt logistic on out-of-fold development scores

unmanned.rule: Development OOF: max F1 subject to FPR <= 0.1% (precision-first, unattended hours)

standard.rule: Development OOF: max F1 subject to FPR <= 1% (default)

screening.rule: Development OOF: highest threshold keeping judged-row recall >= 95% (inspection candidate list)

scope: Dataset state classification with calibrated in-dataset probability; not a field failure probability or lead time
input_units: Source units unknown; site mapping and baseline confirmation required
